text: 据央视，商务部商务大数据显示，全国重点零售和餐饮企业日均销售额比去年农历同期增长6.1%；商务部重点监测的78个步行街（商圈）客流量、营业额分别增长6.4%、5.1%。智能、绿色、健康商品销售火热，重点平台智能穿戴设备销售额增长1.2倍、具身智能机器人销售额增长93.1%、有机食品销售额增长36.3%、户外运动装备销售额增长30.2%。中秋假期前两天，消费品以旧换新惠及190.7万人次，带动销售额115.3亿元。
text_en: According to CCTV, data from the Ministry of Commerce's commerce big data show that average daily sales of key retail and catering enterprises nationwide rose 6.1% from the same lunar period last year; foot traffic and turnover at 78 pedestrian streets (business districts) monitored by the Ministry of Commerce rose 6.4% and 5.1%, respectively. Sales of smart, green and health-related goods were strong, with sales of smart wearable devices on key platforms up 1.2 times, sales of embodied intelligent robots up 93.1%, sales of organic food up 36.3%, and sales of outdoor sports equipment up 30.2%. In the first two days of the Mid-Autumn holiday, consumer goods trade-ins benefited 1.907 million person-times and drove 11.53 billion yuan in sales.
